answer: Bind each earning key to an aged code-hosting account: the key must appear in a signed commit by an author with a year of merged work in repos it doesn't own. Rewards ramp with that history, and authors whose approvals come from one tight nebula of the same few reviewers merge into one share. That track record is nectar clones can't fake cheaply: a farm of N keys must grow N authors through a slow spiral of real, independently reviewed commits.
